description: Use it once the person names or picks one yacht from a search_yachts or best_deals answer: pass its page link, exactly as that answer returned it, as id. It answers the yacht's facts and terms as the source states them (packages, included, required and optional extras, deposit, check-in days and times, stay limits, equipment, the operator's descriptions) and its availability: with from / to, that stay's status and price and, when it is not free, the nearest free stays; without dates, its free stays, soonest first. A field left out is one the source does not state. To compare several, call search_yachts.
